title: Standing Down
summary: Brannoc has heard of the legion in the Old Barrows that held its road for three hundred years because nobody told it to stop. He'd like to stand with it once, the way he never stood with anyone.

steps.journal: Go down to the Old Barrows' second floor or deeper, and hold a stair hall (the room with the stairs down) for five waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in a stair hall, floor 2 or deeper

ready: Tell Brannoc it's done: tap his party card, then Talk.
done: You held the barrows' stair hall with Brannoc. He stood; they stood. He gave you his old chain, less one link.
